sources.title: byteshape/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a GGUF-quantized version of Qwen3.6-35B-A3B with Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) support, produced with ByteShape's ShapeLearn, which learns the optimal datatype per tensor to maintain high quality even at very low bitlengths.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B - vLLM Ascend
sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 1 Introduction ¶ Qwen3.6-35B-A3B is a sparse MoE model in the Qwen3.6 family, with 35B total parameters and about 3B activated parameters per token. It uses the hybrid attention architecture used by Qwen3.5-style models, and is suitable for long-context online serving on Ascend hardware.
